LoloBuy Shipping to the Netherlands: Plan the Full Cost

Record the item first

Keep the selected option, quantity, seller price and domestic delivery charge together. A low item price does not establish the cost of a delivered parcel.

Compare the parcel quote

List actual weight, package dimensions, destination, product types and any optional services. Compare the routes currently shown for that exact parcel; a quote for someone else’s order may not apply.

Add destination charges

Budget separately for import VAT, any applicable duties and carrier handling fees. Check current Dutch rules and whether tax was already collected before paying; keep evidence to avoid assuming a charge has been settled.

Save evidence and review

Save the product record, warehouse photos, quote and final parcel details. Review route restrictions and return options before submission. Quotes and delivery estimates can change and do not guarantee customs clearance.
